notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes and First Day of Class trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the First Day of Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 4.
